text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That was a good session. Um, thank you,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're only scheduled to do half a day of
training today. I think about
how I'm going
to spend my afternoon when Nishino
Flower speaks.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It's already the afternoon...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I misunderstood what you said about
my bentos. I'm really sorry!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll be more careful from now on,
so... Uh...
I guess I'll see you
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to give Nishino Flower money to
pay for the lunch
ingredients, but she runs
off before I can say a word.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What did she mean by misunderstanding? I
wish I could ask her, but I
guess that won't
be possible today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later that afternoon, I'm walking around
the train station when I spot
Nishino
Flower doing some shopping.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes. I came here to get some new
running shoes. Um... Are you out
shopping
too?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
My parents told me it's about time I got
some new ones and sent me
more money
than usual...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
They've been like that even before I
entered Tracen Academy. When it comes
to training, they always go above and
beyond in supporting
me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Mom! Dad! I...
I want to run more! I want to
enter more races!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Then you have our full support! You'll
need a good pair of shoes first.
And you'll
also need...

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
A place where you can train and run to
your heart's content! We might
as well buy
some land, big enough to build facilities
on and—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
They've given me everything I need to run.
It's almost to the point
where I wonder if
I'm not asking for too much...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! They're so kind.
I couldn't be happier
to be their daughter!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But... whenever I go shopping on my own, I
don't know what to get. I
have to use my
money wisely and make a good choice.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're in the middle of your own
shopping, right? I couldn't
impose... You're
probably really busy...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Really? Well, then... Um. Okay! If you
really don't mind. I'll try not to
take up too
much of your time!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Should I get shoes with a bit more
weight to them this time? I
don't know...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I probably should,
especially if I'm going
to step up my training.)

text_block_list.name: Academy Nurse
text_block_list.text:
You'll probably need to focus on
rehabilitation for a while. I'll have a
car
brought around to take you to the
hospital, just in case.

text_block_list.name: Academy Nurse
text_block_list.text:
I know you're starting to train in
earnest, but you're still growing.
Pushing yourself
too hard will have immediate repercussions
on your body. You know that, right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Academy Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Good. You'll be fine—with proper
rehabilitation, you'll be training again
before you know it.
But you have to take it easy for now, all
right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (What if I get into another accident?)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I need to avoid that at all costs.
I don't
want Mom and Dad to worry,
and I'm
already putting a lot on Trainer's plate!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to use resistance
equipment for the entire training period.
There are other methods, like wearing
weighted cleats, that
are just as effective.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I casually mention that gear can be
changed based on Nishino
Flower's
condition at any given time.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Y-you're right! Sorry for eating up
your time...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No. You're using your valuable time to
help me out while I'm standing
around
overthinking.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you,
Trainer. I'll get the regular pair
then!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I won't let your advice go to waste.
I can't
wait to try these new shoes
out tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower dashes off to make her
purchase.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My advice, if you could call it that, was
more of an offhand comment,
but it seems
she's taken it to heart.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's already evening.
I'm sorry for taking up
so much of your time...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to wear these shoes tomorrow,
so I'll need to break them in as
soon as I get
home. I'll be using the standard cleats
and...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So it's not just my imagination. She is behaving differently than normal. She seems overly concerned about how I'll react.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower always makes an effort to
read the room. She thinks about what the
people around her want, and goes out of
her way not
to burden anyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she's probably doing the same thing
with me. However, it's not
healthy to keep
going like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She can share all her burdens with me if
she wants. If something's bothering her, I
don't want her to keep it bottled up.
That's part of what being a trainer is
about.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Is there something...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-you surprised me...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's no problem. But... Hehe. You're
already doing so much for me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So the least I can do is put in the same
effort, so I don't end up just
taking from
you without giving anything back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Nishino Flower's smile, I silently
vow once more to protect that
sunny
expression.
